justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/result/supplement/SupplementalInfoRetriever.java, TitleRetriever.java, ProductResultInfoRetriever.java, BookResultInfoRetriever.java, URIResultInfoRetriever.java, plus the call site in android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/CaptureActivity.java. The package contains only 5 classes and 507 total LOC, organized as one abstract dispatcher/helper and four narrowly scoped retrievers for URI title, redirects, product info, and book info. The code is cohesive and used from a single capture-flow call site, so there is no evidence of an excessively large, responsibility-centralizing package.
